hero.description: Frontend Developer focused on building modern, responsive, and interactive web interfaces. Experienced in creating polished UI experiences with animations, responsive layouts, and real-time interactions.

about: I am a Frontend Developer focused on building modern, responsive, and interactive web interfaces with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Experienced in creating polished UI experiences with animations, responsive layouts, rich components, and real-time interactions using AI-assisted development for faster implementation and iteration.

projects.title: TrackDaily
projects.description: AI-powered nutrition and health journal that turns natural language and food photos into structured meal logs and personalized health insights.

projects.title: ShadowxAI
projects.description: Built a modern, responsive AI chat interface with dark/light themes, smooth animations, responsive sidebar, and adaptive layouts across desktop and mobile. Designed rich chat experiences with Markdown, syntax-highlighted code, LaTeX rendering, streaming responses, image previews, tool states, and interactive message actions.

projects.title: Crisper
projects.description: Built a modern, responsive music interface with track search, YouTube link preview, interactive audio visualizer, animated 5-stage processing UI, and polished result cards. Designed smooth search, loading, progress, and download interactions, with automatic scrolling and real-time SSE updates.

projects.title: PlanetZero
